description: Golden evaluation dataset verifying PRD compliance and AgentOps rubric requirements for the GCC Service Delivery Strategy Agent.

eval_cases.scenario: User provides only Vision and Customer Name; agent must identify the 5 missing sections, pause slide creation, ask clarifying questions, and propose industry-standard assumptions.

initial_input.vision: Migrate core retail banking workloads to Google Cloud and reduce infrastructure TCO by 35% in 12 months.

expected_missing_sections: Operating Model (PSO only, Partner, or both)

eval_cases.scenario: User approves industry-standard assumptions and selects Hybrid PSO & Partner operating model; agent updates sections, passes self-eval, and generates all 6 required PRD slides.

initial_input.vision: Migrate core retail banking workloads to Google Cloud and reduce infrastructure TCO by 35% in 12 months.
